headlines.headline: OKC leads Spurs 3-2, Game 6 tonight; Knicks reach Finals
headlines.detail: Thunder host Game 6 at 8:30 PM ET on NBC/Peacock. Knicks swept Cavs to reach their first Finals since 1999. Finals begin June 3.

headlines.headline: Packers RB Josh Jacobs arrested on domestic abuse charges
headlines.detail: Jacobs arrested Tuesday on 5 charges including domestic abuse battery and strangulation. Team deferred to official statement during OTA week.

headlines.headline: Texas Tech QB Sorsby enters treatment for gambling addiction
headlines.detail: No. 2 transfer portal prospect Brendan Sorsby on indefinite leave. Portal mostly closed with 3,662 entries, 76% committed.

headlines.headline: Michigan wins 2026 title; programs building 2026-27 rosters
headlines.detail: Wolverines claimed their second national title on April 6. Transfer portal mostly closed; Washington fills 12 of 15 roster spots for fall.
